gaps.sentence: She put her ideas ___ clearly and confidently.
gaps.explanation: put across = communicate an idea successfully.

gaps.sentence: During the tour she pointed ___ the oldest house in town.
gaps.explanation: point out = mention/draw attention to a fact.

gaps.sentence: This old house needs doing ___ before winter.
gaps.explanation: do up = repair and decorate a building. (British usage)

gaps.sentence: Their son grew ___ and moved abroad.
They've just moved ___ to their new flat.
gaps.explanation: move in = start living in a new home.

gaps.sentence: Looking back ___ it, the risk was worth taking.
gaps.explanation: look back ON something = remember and think about the past.

gaps.sentence: We found ___ that the flight had been cancelled.
We had to call ___ the order because the kitchen had closed.
